history: The name comes from the way it is traditionally taken — hands behind the back, lifted with the mouth.
whyItWorks: Mechanically it is a Buttery Nipple; the cream cap is there for the ritual more than the flavor.
steps: Pour the butterscotch schnapps into a shot glass.
Layer by pouring each ingredient slowly over the back of a bar spoon so it floats on the one below.
Top with a cap of whipped cream.
Serve with the tradition explained, or not.
name: Blow Job
description: A Buttery Nipple under whipped cream, drunk without hands.
